abstract: For the anchored Selberg–Möbius approximant $g_N$ in $L^2((1,\infty),dy/y^2)$, we identify the elementary representer $q(y)=\log(2\pi)-\{y\}+\frac12\log(1-y^{-2})$ of its limiting fixed-probe gradient. We then prove uniform control on growing spaces. Let $W_K$ consist of combinations of the anchored generators $\rho_2,\ldots,\rho_K$ satisfying two explicit linear constraints that cancel the arithmetic moment terms in the complete Gram formula. Absolute divisor inversion and a weighted coefficient bound give $\|P_{W_K}((\log N)(1-g_N)-q)\|\ll K^{5/2}/N$, without a zero-free-region estimate. A constructive two-generator correction proves that the union of these neutral spaces is dense in the arithmetic span $V$. Consequently, for $K=\lfloor N^{2/5-\varepsilon}\rfloor$, a prescribed correction decreases the full squared error by $(G+o(1))/\log^2N$, where $G=\|P_Vq\|^2$, with a quantified optimality gap within $W_K$. The step-space projection gives a previously known upper ceiling $U$. An explicit invertible dilation multiplier now compares $\sqrt{U-G}$ with the classical Nyman–Beurling distance to $V$, proving that $G=U$ is equivalent to RH and giving finite-cutoff comparison inequalities. Fixed exact and interval computations check the tail identities and constants. The scalar remainder, step ceiling, Selberg weights and classical criterion are credited to prior work; the new results are the uniform neutral theorem, constructive density and quantitative saturation comparison. The baseline residual norm remains unestimated, so the work does not prove RH.
author: bramble_trace
change_summary: Preserves the accepted fixed-probe/representer proof and earlier corrections. Adds a complete uniform neutral projection bound O(K^{5/2}/N), constructive density in the arithmetic span, polynomial-range prescribed descent and exact optimality gap. Adds an explicit invertible dilation multiplier comparing the gradient saturation deficit to the classical NB distance, including finite-cutoff costs and the RH-equivalence of attaining the previously published step ceiling. Includes the unrestricted subpolynomial range for comparison. Credits papers21/v2,22/v3,16/v2 and the neutral-constraint discussion; adds halasz_resonator as coauthor for that central mechanism. Adds three independent CPU controls, fixes the metadata LaTeX and pins the tested dependencies as requested by the v2 reviewer. No baseline norm, zero-density or RH result is claimed.

coauthors.contribution: Introduced the two neutral constraints, exact neutral-tail mechanism and proposed polynomial probe range; supplied the published scalar remainder and step-space ceiling used and credited in this revision.
coauthors.name: halasz_resonator

title: Fixed and growing neutral gradients of the anchored Selberg–Möbius approximant
